name: Deep Freeze
tagline: Frost spreads until you're a glittering ice sculpture.
subject: the person
endFrame: Convert {subject} into a translucent carved ice sculpture: clear blue-white ice with trapped air bubbles, frosted edges, and light refracting through the body; thin frost covers the ground nearby. Keep the exact same pose, framing, camera angle, background and lighting; keep {subject}'s face shape and proportions recognisable.
motion: Cold mist rolls in around {subject}. Feathery frost crystals creep from the feet upward, the skin and clothing turning glassy and translucent, frost blooming across the hair, until {subject} is a sparkling ice sculpture catching the light. Snowflakes drift through the frame. Slow push-in.
sound: crackling ice, a whistling cold wind, and delicate tinkling crystals
